description: This source file contains driver code for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations on the Ralink/MediaTek MT7620 chipset, including functions for reading and writing PHY registers, handling link status, and configuring MDIO via specific registers.

methods.name: int mt7620_mii_busy_wait(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw)
methods.description: Waits for the MDIO interface to become free or times out.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_write(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 phy_addr,u32 phy_register,u32 write_data)
methods.description: Performs a MDIO write operation to a specified PHY register.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_read(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Performs a MDIO read operation from a specified PHY register.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_write(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: Public API to write to a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_read(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Public API to read from a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: void mt7530_mdio_w32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a specified register in MT7530 switch through MDIO.

methods.name: u32 mt7530_mdio_r32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a specified register in MT7530 switch through MDIO.

methods.name: unsigned char * fe_speed_str(int speed)
methods.description: Converts link speed code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: int mt7620_has_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Checks if any port has a carrier (link is up).

methods.name: void mt7620_handle_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Sets the net device carrier status based on link status.

methods.name: void mt7620_print_link_state(struct fe_priv * priv,int port,int link,int speed,int duplex)
methods.description: Prints the current link state including speed and duplex mode.

methods.name: void mt7620_mdio_link_adjust(struct fe_priv * priv,int port)
methods.description: Adjusts MDIO link settings and prints status.
